title: NIDS study correlating triangle sightings to US naval bases

tellings.quote: Uh there's that famous NID study done in the I think late 90s or early 2000s where they correlate triangle sightings to naval bases in the United States.

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, mentions a study by NIDS, the National Institute for Discovery Science, a private group that researched unexplained phenomena. He says that in the late 1990s or early 2000s, as far as he remembers, the study matched reports of triangle-shaped flying objects to the locations of US naval bases. If true, it would hint at a link between these craft and the Navy.
